description: This file contains utility functions for date formatting and calculations, including padding numbers, getting ISO-formatted dates, computing week ranges, and calculating streaks based on date history.

methods.name: pad(n)
methods.description: Pads single-digit numbers with a leading zero for formatting.

methods.name: getISODate(d = new Date())
methods.description: Returns an ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for a given date or the current date.

methods.name: getWeekRange(date = new Date())
methods.description: Calculates the start of the week (Monday) for a given date and returns the ISO date of the start along with an array of ISO dates for each day of that week.

methods.name: computeStreak(history = {})
methods.description: Counts the number of consecutive days (up to 3650 days) marked as true in the provided history object, counting backwards from today.
